scope: Single environment draw per scenario; paired exploratory supplemental baseline, not a new formal test.
rr_contract: u = slot mod 5, fixed beam 2, direct-only, relay==UE, tracking bit clear; one UE is offered one action per slot.
feedback_scope: Existing causal-feedback scheme-4 adaptation, no offline training; evaluated only to complete a same-draw visual comparison.
caveats: One training seed for learned methods; one environment draw per scene.
RR is a strict lower reference and not an optimized TDMA scheduler.
Feedback MAB is online-adaptive and does not have the same state/budget as PPO.
Short finite horizon cannot establish stability or generalization.
